title: Personality questionnaires: scoring, limitations and reuse rights
description: Understand the five frameworks in AgentTune research, current questionnaire availability, scoring and instrument-specific reuse rights.
dek: Choose a questionnaire, understand its score, and review the source terms.
lede: Take any of AgentTune’s five questionnaire adaptations: MBTI-style, Enneagram, DISC, attachment or Big Five. All 43 communication templates remain available. Questionnaires are optional; you can choose preferences directly.
answer: All five tests run locally in your browser with instant results and no signup. The four restored tests preserve their previous website editions; Big Five reports raw totals and means. A questionnaire score is not a diagnosis or evidence that a tuning improves performance.

sections.html:
Take the MBTI-style, Enneagram, DISC, attachment or Big Five questionnaire. Complete all items to view a score; tied results stay explicit.

Read the per-instrument rights record before reusing questionnaire material. Original software and template licenses do not relicense third-party question text.

Complete all 50 items using the versioned response scale. Reverse keyed items use 6 minus the response. Each dimension sums ten scored items (10–50); its average is the total divided by ten (1–5). Invalid values are rejected and missing responses produce no final score.

Current results contain no population percentiles, reference indices or automatic template selection. Neuroticism reverses the direction of IPIP Emotional Stability; Openness corresponds to Intellect/Imagination. The specification records the adaptation.

Published studies used legacy adaptations and, in some cases, deterministic tie-break labels. MBTI item 1 and two Enneagram items had undocumented substitutions. Preserve those edition identities when interpreting the results. Raw vectors and numerical results remain unchanged; restricted item wording in public downloads is replaced by stable item labels.

Correction and source hashes · Reproduce the arithmetic.

Questionnaires are optional. Use the preference builder to request the detail, warmth, structure and pushback you want. Review each rule before saving it. No framework or score outranks your explicit request, accuracy or authorized scope.

faq.q: Are all five questionnaires MIT licensed?
faq.a: No. Original AgentTune templates and code have their own license; instrument content has separate terms. Review the rights record before reuse.

faq.q: Does the Big Five result show a population percentile?
faq.a: No. It reports raw dimension totals and item means. The former reference constants had no verified normative sample.
